title: DynamiQ: Unlocking the Potential of Dynamic Task Allocation in Parallel Fuzzing
abstract: arXiv:2510.04469v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present DynamiQ, a full-fledged and optimized successor to AFLTeam that supports dynamic and adaptive parallel fuzzing. Unlike most existing approaches that treat individual seeds as tasks, DynamiQ leverages structural information from the program's call graph to define tasks and continuously refines task allocation using runtime feedback. This design significantly reduces redundant exploration and enhances fuzzing efficiency at scale. Built on top of the state-of-the-art LibAFL framework, DynamiQ incorporates several practical optimizations in both task allocation and task-aware fuzzing. We evaluate DynamiQ on eighteen targets from Magma and FuzzBench with a total budget of over 40 CPU years. It achieves the highest mean branch coverage on fourteen targets, with average relative gains ranging from 8.37% to 19.53% over five baseline fuzzers. Across our experiments, DynamiQ identifies nine previously unknown bugs.

translated_title: DynamiQ：释放并行模糊测试中动态任务分配的潜力
translated_abstract: 我们提出了DynamiQ，它是AFLTeam的全面完善且经过优化的后继版本，支持动态和自适应的并行模糊测试。与大多数将单个种子视为任务的现有方法不同，DynamiQ利用程序调用图的结构信息来定义任务，并通过运行时反馈持续优化任务分配。这种设计显著减少了冗余探索，并提升了大规模场景下的模糊测试效率。DynamiQ构建在最先进的LibAFL框架之上，在任务分配和任务感知模糊测试两方面都融入了多项实用优化。我们在Magma和FuzzBench的十八个目标上对DynamiQ进行了评估，总预算超过40个CPU年。它在十四个目标上取得了最高的平均分支覆盖率，相较于五个基线模糊测试器的平均相对提升幅度为8.37%至19.53%。在全部实验中，DynamiQ共发现了九个此前未知的漏洞。
tldr: DynamiQ利用程序调用图结构定义任务并基于运行时反馈动态调整任务分配，大幅减少了并行模糊测试中的冗余探索，在超过40 CPU年的评估中显著提升分支覆盖率并发现了9个未知漏洞。
en_tdlr: DynamiQ defines fuzzing tasks based on program call graph structure and dynamically refines task allocation with runtime feedback, significantly reducing redundant exploration in parallel fuzzing, achieving up to 19.53% relative coverage gains and discovering 9 previously unknown bugs.
